dependencyRationale: Production assembly crosses Compose, root, data, platform, Android and iOS entrypoints, native resources, generated SQLDelight models and shared build configuration. A repository-wide immutable scope avoids omitting transitive native or resource inputs for the final cross-platform integration receipts.
fallbackReason: The retained application graph and platform adapters transitively depend on all shared modules plus Android/iOS host configuration; a narrower manual list would be less reliable than the small repository-wide fingerprint.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; AGP 9.1.1; Compose Multiplatform; Decompose/MVIKotlin; SQLDelight 2.4.0; Android API 23-37; iOS arm64/simulator arm64
